description: Security fixes bypass the 3-day global cooldown, but not entirely:
pnpm enforces its own 24h `minimumReleaseAge` floor at install time
(built-in default as of pnpm 11 — there is no repo-level config for it).
At '0 days' Renovate could open a PR whose lockfile references a release
younger than that floor; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` then fails with
ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION, so CI never goes green and the
`automerge` below can't fire — a security PR blocked by construction.
'1 day' makes the two gates agree. It costs nothing real: the PR has to
wait for CI regardless, and install time is always later than lockfile
generation time, so the age only grows between the two checks.
Note this gates the *updated* package only. Transitives floated by
lockFileMaintenance aren't covered here; pnpm's floor stays the backstop
for those, and a failed install just means re-running once it ages out.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge safe update types when CI is green.
Astro integrations (sitemap, rss, etc — versioned independently of core).
typescript-eslint parser + plugin MUST share a version.
ESLint plugins — move together to avoid plugin/eslint-core mismatches.
Type definitions — additive, low-risk; group all update types incl. major.
GitHub Actions on their own track (digest pins maintained by best-practices preset).
